players.outlook: Jonathan Taylor was not traded prior to Tuesday's deadline. He has rushed for 656 yards and eight TDs through nine games with the Colts, putting the star RB on pace for a fifth campaign with at least 1,169 rushing yards and 11 TDs. Taylor has a juicy Week 10 matchup against the 1-7 Dolphins. Despite staying with the Colts, he remains a set-and-forget fantasy RB1.

Luther Burden will look to stay busy as the Bears play the Buccaneers in Week 9. Burden stayed hot in a Week 8 MNF win over the Seahawks, bringing in seven of nine targets for 56 yards and a touchdown. The second-year wide receiver now has a 19-281-2 line on 21 targets across the last three games, and he's surpassed 50 receiving yards in all but two games this season. He'll face a Tampa Bay defense that's ranked eighth in fantasy points allowed to WRs.

news.text: Bears head coach Ben Johnson confirmed Tuesday that Burden has cleared concussion protocol, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.. Burden's status was up in the air for a bit with the Bears going on bye immediately after he sustained a concussion in a Week 9 win over the  Buccaneers, but he was spotted working out on the field with teammates Monday and has apparently cleared all five phases of the protocol. The second-year wideout looks like he'll be a full practice participant throughout Week 11, and he shouldn't face any playing-time limitations in Sunday's game versus the Saints.

players.outlook: Kirk Cousins is coming off his worst performance of the season, getting picked off three times while throwing just one touchdown in the Raiders' Week 9 loss to the 49ers. With Las Vegas now 4-5, the team elected to hand the reins of the offense to rookie Fernando Mendoza by trading Cousins back to the franchise he had the most success with, the Vikings. Cousins' 20 TD passes through nine games is second in the NFL behind Joe Burrow's 23, and he's fifth in passing yards. Ashton Jeanty is coming off another poor effort, managing just 20 scrimmage yards on 11 touches in the Raiders' Week 9 loss to the 49ers. This time, he wasn't overshadowed by rookie Mike Washington, who lost a total of three yards on his six carries. Jeanty maintains a shaky hold on the top spot in the backfield, but he hasn't reached 30 rushing yards in a game since Week 4, and his contributions of late have been limited to his usage as a pass-catcher. Jeanty isn't likely to turn things around in Week 10 against a Seahawks defense that ranks 13th in fantasy points per game allowed to RBs.

Tyler Bass continues to see heavy volume in the Bills' prolific offense ahead of a Week 10 matchup with the Jets. Seemingly always assured of a handful of PATs, making at least two in every game, Bass has at least three field goals in four straight games, creating double-digit scoring upside with consistency. The Jets are allowing the ninth-fewest fantasy points per game to opposing kickers however, largely due to opponents converting drives into touchdowns, surrendering just 13 field goal attempts in nine games, which should test Bass' current form.

news.text: Bass made his sole field-goal attempt and all four PATs in the Bills' 31-12 win over the Jets on Sunday.. Bass made a 37-yard field goal in the second quarter of Sunday's contest. The kicker continues his perfect streak, having made all 20 of his field-goal attempts so far in 2026, with three such conversions coming from beyond 50 yards.

Rice led the Chiefs in receiving yards and finished second in receptions and targets on a prolific afternoon for the Chiefs' air attack. Rice didn't get in on the scoring fun of a five-touchdown day for Patrick Mahomes, but he still eclipsed 80 receiving yards for the third time this season and first time since Week 3. Rice's level of involvement was encouraging given the debuting Josh Downs drew five targets, keeping the former's prospects bright for a favorable Week 11 home matchup against the Cardinals next Sunday.

players.outlook: George Pickens did not suit up last game for Dallas due to a hamstring ailment. His status for Week 10 versus the 49ers remains up in the air. Even if Pickens is able to play, he will face a difficult task. The Niners are allowing just 211 passing yards per tilt, which is eighth in the league. In addition, San Fran has given up just 11 passing scores in 2026, which is tied for seventh in the NFL.

Gordon has 16 or more carries in three straight games and five of his last six, scoring four times and topping 100 yards twice. He has no major competition for carries with Jaylen Wright injured and sparingly used even when healthy. Indianapolis is allowing 4.8 yards per carry, the third-highest mark in the league, setting Gordon up to take advantage of a big workload.

Kaelon Black has been running well for the 49ers of late and will look to continue to do so Week 10 versus the Cowboys. Black has rushed for at least 63 yards in each of his past two games and is averaging a hearty 5.8 yards per carry during that span. He's still not factoring into the passing game and continues to work considerably behind top RB Christian McCaffrey, but Black is proving himself to be a capable NFL back during his rookie campaign. The addition of Kirk Cousins at the trade deadline to be the new starting QB may not be good news for Hockenson, however, as he's more likely to targets wideouts Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison than Kyler Murray or Carson Wentz did. He'll have one more opportunity to get back to full Friday, at which point the Vikings may tag him with a designation ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.

Assuming he can receive clearance from an independent neurologist by the weekend, Waddle will be removed from the protocol and suit up Sunday versus the Raiders.

However, he has just three touchdown passes in three road games. Jacksonville has won its last two games by a 75-17 margin, so Lawrence has been afforded the luxury of taking his foot off the gas. This has limited his production after back-to-back 300-yard passing performances in a pair of competitive games in London. news.text: Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.. It was another huge performance from the 27-year-old QB, as Lawrence set a new season high in passing yards and threw at least three TDs for the fifth time in nine games to begin the year. He spread the ball around again, as seven different Jaguars caught multiple passes and Parker Washington, Josh Cameron and Brenton Strange were all on the other end of scores. Lawrence will take a sharp 21:5 TD:INT into a Week 11 clash with the Giants.

players.outlook: No team has as soft a schedule on the defensive side of things than do the Ravens; only the Cowboys (Week 3), Bengals (7 and 17) and Bills (8) stand out as particularly challenging matchups. That's a good thing, considering this unit finished a disappointing 21st in scoring last season. The Ravens still have stars on the defensive side, and the change in head coach to Jesse Minter and defensive coordinator to Anthony Weaver should fuel a rebound to some degree.

Buffalo's defense is middling in terms of fantasy points allowed to opposing quarterbacks, but they've given up 15 touchdown passes through eight games, and the game flow will likely force the Jets to throw frequently while trailing. players.outlook: Carnell Tate sat out Tennessee's Week 8 loss to the Bengals prior to a Week 9 bye due to a shoulder injury. The rookie, fourth overall pick is expected to return in Week 10 against the Jaguars and will likely reprise his role as the top option in Tennessee's underwhelming passing offense. Tate racked up at least 69 yards in three of his last four appearances, making him a strong flex play in a game that's likely to feature a negative game script for the 1-7 Titans, leading to more passes. The 6-2 Jaguars are allowing 175 yards per game to WRs, though they have limited the position to four TDs.

news.text: Tate (shoulder) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.. Tate appears to be tracking toward a Week 11 return against Dallas after he's missed the last two games against Cincinnati and Jacksonville. The Titans could definitely use the rookie wideout after Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) was placed on season-ending injured reserve earlier this week. Tate's return would likely push Chimere Dike back into WR4 duties, with Xavier Restrepo the more sensible slot replacement for Robinson.

players.outlook: Kyle Pitts will look to rebound from a poor performance in Atlanta's Week 10 matchup against the Chiefs. After catching 15 of 18 targets for 122 yards and four touchdowns from Weeks 5 through 7, Pitts has really struggled. In his last two games, the Florida product has hauled in just five of 10 targets for 29 yards and no scores, making him too inconsistent to be a week-in and week-out starter going forward. However, he's in for a favorable Week 10 matchup against a Kansas City defense that's allowed 17.0 fantasy points per game to opposing tight ends this season.

Darren Waller will look to continue building on his stellar performance in the Panthers' Week 10 matchup against the Saints. Waller is coming off his best game of the season in the Week 9 loss to the Broncos, catching eight of 10 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown. He's clearly established himself as Carolina's top receiving tight end, leading the team's TE corps in targets (34), receptions (23), yards (299) and touchdowns (four) through eight games. Additionally, Waller is in for a great Week 10 matchup against a New Orleans defense that's allowed 16.1 fantasy points per game to opposing TE

news.text: Waller (knee) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN reports.. One day removed from being a non-participant Wednesday due to a knee injury, Waller was able to mix into some drills, but he now has just one more chance to get back to full Friday, at which point his odds to suit up Sunday against the Ravens will become known.

players.outlook: Adonai Mitchell's roller coaster season heads into a favorable spot when the Jets face the Bills in Week 10. He failed to record a catch in Week 9 despite seven targets, his second game in three weeks without a reception. Mitchell remains a vertical option, and he's averaged 6.8 targets across five healthy appearances. With the Jets likely throwing from behind as the game progresses, he's a reasonable bet to flourish against a secondary that's allowed 28 receptions of 20-plus yards, the eighth-most in the league.

David Montgomery (groin) is apparently nearing a return to practice, but he still looks likely to remain sidelined in Week 10 against the Browns. He hasn't suited up since exiting in Week 5, with Woody Marks leading Houston's backfield in the interim. Even if Montgomery gains clearance to play in Week 10, he'll be a risky flex option considering he was averaging just 2.7 yards per carry prior to getting injured while working in a timeshare with Marks.

news.text: Montgomery (groin) doesn't have an injury designation and is expected to play in Thursday's game against the Colts, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.. Montgomery was sidelined for the Texans' past four games due to the groin injury, but he's good to go for the Week 11 matchup after he was listed as a full practice participant from Monday through Wednesday. Before going down with the injury, Montgomery had been part of a timeshare with Woody Marks, but Montgomery will have a fairly clear path to a lead role Thursday with Marks sidelined due to a concussion. Montgomery made a splash in his Texans debut with three touchdowns in a Week 1 loss to the Bills, but he accrued just 126 scoreless

players.outlook: Jadarian Price looks to be settling in as Seattle's No. 2 RB ahead of a Week 10 clash against Las Vegas. The rookie running back handled 13 touches this past Sunday in a win over Arizona while Zach Charbonnet logged 17 touches. However, Charbonnet had 16 carries to Prize's nine, suggesting that the former may be leaning more toward a change-of-pace role. Both Charbonnet and Price could be utilized heavily against the Raiders, who have given up the second-most fantasy points per game (23.1) to running backs this season.

In Week 10, Quinshon Judkins and the Browns return home for the first time in three weeks to host the Texans. He rushed 15 times for 43 yards and caught his only target for two yards during Cleveland's overtime loss in Week 9. Judkins and the entire Browns offense struggled to make much happen on the ground, registering 95 yards on 34 carries for a meager 2.8 yards per attempt. Judkins has been underwhelming in 2026, racking up 385 yards on 116 carries (3.3 YPC) with three TDs and a 22-136-0 receiving line on 25 targets. He'll try to turn things around versus a Houston defense allowing 22.4 fa

Chuba Hubbard is expected to remain Carolina's bell-cow back during the Week 10 matchup against the Saints. Hubbard has now logged 20-plus touches in five of the Panthers' last six games, averaging the eighth-most touches per game (20.0) in the NFL this year. His receiving volume has jumped over the last three weeks as well, catching 15 of 18 targets for 82 yards during that span. Hubbard figures to have a huge game in Week 10 against a New Orleans defense that has allowed the most fantasy points per game to opposing running backs (28.6) this season.

news.text: Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 92 yards and two touchdowns and caught all five of his targets for 80 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.. The 27-year-old RB kept the Panthers' offense afloat nearly single-handedly, as he set a new career high with 172 scrimmage yards while scoring both the team's TDs, on a two-yard run in the first quarter and a one-yard plunge in the fourth. Hubbard's 80 receiving yards were easily a new career high, topping the 3-57-0 line on three targets he recorded in Week 15 of the 2022 season against the Steelers. Over Hubbard's last six games, he surged to 697 scrimmage yards and six rushing touchdowns, and he'll look keep rolling in a Week 11 clash w

players.outlook: Tanner McKee continues to struggle under center for the Eagles, though admittedly he is working with limited help. Though running back Saquon Barkley returned from injury in the loss to Washington, staring wideouts Devonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks remained sidelined, and the right side of the offensive line is still a work in progress. McKee had two turnovers while failing to throw a touchdown against the Commanders. In Week 9, McKee will face a much-improved Giants pass defense. Audric Estime is expected to operate as the Saints' top rusher in the Week 10 matchup against the Panthers. Following the release of Kendre Miller prior to the Week 9 win over the Browns, Estime was New Orleans' leading rusher, taking 15 carries for 72 yards and a touchdown. He logged the most rushing yards of any player on the Saints in a single game this season, making his case to remain the team's top rusher, despite both CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion) and Travis Etienne (hamstring) returning from injuries in the near future. If Etienne remains sidelined, Estime projects to have another

Kyler Murray's status is up in the air for Week 10 as the Vikings play the Packers due to a hamstring injury, but the trade deadline acquisition of Kirk Cousins to be the new starting QB leaves the former Cardinal competing with Carson Wentz for the No. 2 job when he's healthy.

news.text: Murray (hamstring) will miss Wednesday's practice, Kevin Seifert of ESPN reports.. The Vikings are targeting a Week 12 matchup with the Falcons on Sunday, Nov. 29, for Murray to be available again, so his lack of activity this week doesn't come as a susprise. Whenever Murray is back, though, he likely will take on No. 2 QB duties due to the arrival of Kirk Cousins from Las Vegas at the trade deadline.

players.outlook: Malik Willis is headed for the IR after an MRI revealed a core-muscle injury. The diagnosis will sideline him through at least Week 13. Kyle McCord is poised to take over under center.

news.text: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.. Per Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald, Hafley noted on that subject Monday, "We will see how he feels. If he needs surgery, he will have surgery," while adding that if the QB does undergo a procedure, it wouldn't "necessarily" be season ending. In any case, the earliest Willis can come off IR is Week 14, with Kyle McCord and Brady Cook currently available to handle Miami's signal-caller duties.

players.outlook: Kenny Gainwell will look to stay hot in the Buccaneers' Week 9 matchup against the Bears. He racked up a career-high 140 rushing yards on 25 carries in the Week 8 win over the Falcons, bringing his season total to 289 yards (5.0 yards per carry). Despite Gainwell's huge performance, he still remains firmly behind Bucky Irving in the Buccaneers' backfield. Gainwell could struggle, especially against a strong Bears defense that has allowed just three rushing touchdowns to RBs all season.

Jaxson Dart was electric in Week 1 for the New York Giants. Dart threw for 230 yards and three touchdowns, while also rushing for an additional 54 yards in the stunning 28-20 win over the Cowboys. Dart threw just five incompletions and showed excellent rapport with new tight end Isaiah Likely. Dart was accurate, decisive and poised in what amounted to an extremely promising start to the season for the G-Men. In Week 2, the Giants will face a Los Angeles Rams defense that was surprisingly poor in their opener, allowing 379 scrimmage yards, which ranks them in the bottom third of the NFL. The Ra

news.text: Dart recently underwent surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.. Dart's ACL and PCL were apparently spared, but the quarterback remains done for the 2026 regular season after he was injured in the first quarter of Week 2 against the Rams. It's unclear if Dart could make a postseason return if the Giants are able to make it that far. Jameis Winston and newly acquired J.J. McCarthy will handle quarterback duties moving forward this season.

players.outlook: Bryce Young is expected to continue leading the Panthers' offense during the Week 10 matchup against the Saints. Young played well despite a loss in Week 9 against the Broncos, throwing for 276 yards, three touchdowns and an interception. He remains tied for the league-lead in passing attempts per game (38.5) and fourth in passing yards per game (274.6). which are both positive signs for his outlook going forward. Additionally, Young is in for a favorable Week 10 matchup against a Saints defense that's allowed 21.2 fantasy points per game to opposing quarterbacks this year.

Baker Mayfield is expected to lead the Buccaneers' passing game into the Week 9 matchup against the Bears. He was the first quarterback since 1974 to win a game without completing a single pass, doing so in a rainy Week 8 divisional matchup against the Falcons. Since returning from injury in Week 7, Mayfield has attempted just 14 total passes, partially due to last week's rainy conditions. However, offensive coordinator Zac Robinson has heavily leaned on the ground game over the last four weeks, which is a poor sign for Mayfield's fantasy outlook. news.text: Mayfield (foot/right thumb) officially was limited at Thursday's practice.. Mayfield came out of the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye with a foot injury, which kept him out of drills Wednesday. After resuming on-field work Thursday, he relayed to Scott Smith of the team's official site that he felt good and was "limited," the latter of which has been confirmed. Per NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano, Mayfield also said, "If I feel like [Jalon Daniels] gives us a better chance to win, I have no shame in admitting that." As a result, it appears as if both Mayfield and Daniels have a chance to be under center for Tampa Bay on Sunday at Detroit.

players.outlook: Jacory Croskey-Merritt rushed for a season-high 82 yards last game for the Commanders. Bill also found the end zone for the second time this season. Croskey-Merritt has seen double-digit touches in every contest thus far in 2026. In Week 6, Washington will face the San Francisco 49ers. The Niners are allowing 97.6 rushing yards per tilt, which is 10th in the NFL. San Francisco has also given up just three rushing touchdowns through five outings, which is tied for sixth in the league.

news.text: Croskey-Merritt (groin) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.. The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt for return from injured reserve Tuesday, and in the team's first official practice of Week 11 prep, he was uninhibited. Assuming he's able to maintain that activity level Friday and Saturday, he's a good bet to miss the minimum four games on IR due to the groin injury that bothered him multiple weeks through the first five contests of the campaign.

players.outlook: MarShawn Lloyd will aim to shed an injury tag as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Lloyd was inactive in Week 9 against the Patriots with a knee injury, which paved the way for Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong to lead Green Bay's rushing attack after Josh Jacobs exited with a finger ailment. If Lloyd is active against Minnesota, he could very well lead the backfield versus a defense that's ranked top 10 in fantasy points allowed to RBs.

Jacoby Brissett and the Ravens host the Chargers on Monday Night Football in Week 10. After being acquired via trade from the Cardinals, Brissett is expected to earn his first start for Baltimore. In eight outings with Arizona, he completed 193 of 305 pass attempts (63.3%) for 1,719 yards with a 10:7 TD:INT ratio, to go along with 29 carries for 87 yards and one score. The Ravens desperately need Brissett's veteran presence under center with Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) both on IR. Baltimore has scored exactly 10 points in three of their last four games, with their best mark b

RJ Harvey logged just five touches in the Broncos' Week 7 win over the Cardinals, but he turned one of them into a 52-yard TD reception in the third quarter to salvage his day. The second-year back finished third in the backfield in workload behind rookie Jonah Coleman (11 touches) and veteran J.K. Dobbins (six touches), but Harvey seems to have a steady role as a passing-down option for Bo Nix. Even if Sean Payton continues to roll with a committee approach to his ground game, Harvey's floor should be relatively secure, even if his ceiling is limited to occasional big plays. news.text: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.. Harvey was already ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Chiefs, but now that he's on IR, the second-year running back will be required to miss at least the next four games. That means the earliest that he is eligible to return is Week 13 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Dec. 6. In Harvey's absence, the Broncos' backfield will be led by J.K. Dobbins and rookie fourth-rounder Jonah Coleman.

players.outlook: Jared Goff will look to return to dominance as the Lions play the Patriots in Week 10. Goff was stuffed again in a narrow Week 9 win over the Dolphins, completing 17 of 25 passes for just 170 yards with zero touchdowns and an interception. The veteran quarterback has now thrown for a disappointing 346 yards and a 1:2 TD:INT in the last two weeks. He'll face a New England defense that ceded 372 passing yards and three touchdowns to Jordan Love in Week 9.

Michael Penix will lead the Falcons' offense into the Week 10 matchup against the Chiefs. Penix has underwhelmed over Atlanta's last two games, completing just 28 of 55 pass attempts for 287 yards, one touchdown and five interceptions. This is especially disappointing considering Penix's terrific start to the year, in which he averaged 231.4 passing yards and 1.8 passing touchdowns per game, while turning the ball over just twice over his first five appearances. Penix's struggles will likely continue in Week 10, as he's set to face a Kansas City defense that's given up just 16.1 fantasy points
De'Von Achane will miss the remainder of the season after tearing his ACL. Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright will handle the bulk of the Dolphins' carries.

news.text: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.. Achane's move to injured reserve was merely a formality after head coach Jeff Hafley confirmed earlier Monday that the running back would be lost for the season after sustaining an ACL tear in his left knee during Sunday's 24-10 loss to Kansas City. With Achane out of the mix for the rest of 2026, the Dolphins are left with Jaylen Wright (foot) and Ollie Gordon as the lone running backs on the 53-man roster.

players.outlook: Deshaun Watson and the Browns welcome his former team to town when they host the Texans in Week 10. He was inactive for Cleveland's 23-22 overtime loss in Week 9 due to a concussion sustained in Week 8's loss. Shedeur Sanders earned his first start of the season, but Watson is healthy and expected to retain his role as the starting QB versus Houston. He'll battle a Texans defense allowing 21.8 fantasy points per game (25th) to the position.

Sam Darnold is slated to miss Seattle's Week 10 matchup against Las Vegas due to a quadriceps injury. Drew Lock is dealing with an oblique issue but is expected to be able to start at quarterback for a second straight week.

news.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.. Darnold, who last played in Week 8, still is working his way through a pair of injuries, but barring any setbacks, he's trending toward a Week 12 return. Macdonald reiterated that Darnold will be the team's starter once healthy, even though backup Drew Lock has guided Seattle to a 4-0 record while coming on in relief or starting in place of an injured Darnold in the first two games of the season as w

players.outlook: Tyler Shough is expected to continue leading the Saints' offense during the Week 10 matchup against the Panthers. Shough played turnover-free football in the Week 9 overtime win over the Browns, completing 21 of 35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown. He remains tied for the league-lead in passing attempts per game (38.5). Additionally, 2026 first-round pick Jordyn Tyson made his season debut in Week 9, suggesting Shough's fantasy outlook is very positive going forward. Shough could continue to thrive in Week 10 against a Carolina defense that's allowed 20.4 fantasy points per game to opposin

J.J. McCarthy is battling a hip pointer, but should be able to suit up in Week 10 for the Giants versus the Commanders. McCarthy briefly left New York's last contest versus the Eagles due to the issue, but was able to return and ultimately guide the G-Men to victory. Though McCarthy passed for a season-low 127 yards last game, he will look to rebound against a porous Washington secondary. The Commanders are allowing 240 passing yards per clash, which is 30th in the league. In addition, Washington has surrendered 16 passing touchdowns, which is tied for 25th in the league.

Jameis Winston was benched in favor of J.J. McCarthy last game for the Giants. McCarthy led a furious comeback attempt, throwing for an astonishing 243 yards in the fourth quarter alone in relief of Winston. While the G-Men ultimately lost to the Saints by a score of 34-27, McCarthy's near-heroics have likely created a quarterback controversy heading into Week 7 versus the Texans. Whomever lines up under center may have a favorable matchup, as Houston is allowing 246 passing yards per tilt, which is 27th in the league.

After a miserable 2025 that saw them surrender the most yards while scoring the third-fewest fantasy points, the Commanders brought in a slew of offseason reinforcements, though it was more of a quantitative than qualitative process. There's no reason to trust this D/ST in Weeks 1 and 2, which are road matchups with the Eagles and Cowboys, but if the Commanders show midseason promise, bear in mind its most favorable matchups come during the season's second half.

Drew Lock  is expected to start for Seattle in Week 10 against Las Vegas despite managing an oblique injury. It will be the second straight start for Lock, as Sam Darnold is slated to sit out again due to a quad injury. Lock led the Seahawks to a win this past Sunday against the Cardinals but put up modest numbers, throwing for 175 yards and one touchdown with no interceptions. He'll have a good matchup against the Raiders, who have allowed a 103.6 QB rating to passers this season, fourth-worst in the NFL.

Dylan Sampson and the Browns return home to face off against Houston in Week 10. He had eight carries for 21 yards and caught three of six targets for 27 yards during Cleveland's Week 9 overtime loss. Sampson finished tied for second on the team in targets, and with the Browns' offense likely to play from behind most weeks, he could provide a boost as the preferred back on passing downs. Sampson will aim to contribute more facing a Houston defense allowing 22.4 fantasy points per game (20th) to opposing RBs.

Rico Dowdle and the Steelers travel to take on the Bengals for a Week 10 AFC North showdown. He had his best showing of the season during Week 8's victory, rushing 15 times for 56 yards and his first touchdown with Pittsburgh. Dowdle battled a toe injury in the early portion of the season, but he's starting to come along, tallying 15 touches in each of his previous two outings. He will look to keep improving versus Cincinnati's 15th-ranked defense in fantasy points allowed per game (20.9) to RBs.

Kyle McCord is slated to take over the helm for the Dolphins after starting QB Malik Willis was diagnosed with a core-muscle injury, sending him to the IR until at least Week 14. An impressive camp earned McCord the backup role, but he has yet to log any action this season. When he does, it will be on the road against a Colts defense vulnerable to the run, so expect McCord to spend most of Week 10 handing the ball off to Ollie Gordon, Mike Washington and perhaps Jaylen Wright (quad).

Jalon Daniels is expected to start at quarterback if Baker Mayfield (thumb) remains sidelined for the Buccaneers' Week 7 matchup against the Panthers. Daniels struggled against the Steelers defense in a Week 6 overtime loss, throwing for 164 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions while adding 39 yards on nine carries. Over his first three NFL starts, Daniels has accounted for just three touchdowns and five turnovers, suggesting he'll carry minimal fantasy value going forward. Despite this, Daniels could be in for a favorable Week 7 matchup against a Carolina defense that's given up 146 rus

Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers are in Cincinnati for a Week 10 showdown on Sunday Night Football. In a Week 8 victory over Cleveland, he threw for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception, snapping a five-game streak of at least one TD pass. Pittsburgh relied on its ground game in that win, rushing 33 times compared to just 25 pass attempts. Rodgers will have to throw more in order to keep pace with the high-scoring Bengals' offense. He'll try to repeat his Week 3 performance when he threw for 292 yards with three TDs and one INT during the Steelers' first matchup with their division

Isiah Pacheco will remain inactive in Week 10 as the Lions play the Patriots. Pacheco was placed on IR to start the season due to a back injury, and he underwent surgery in mid-September. This puts the former Kansas City RB's return this season in jeopardy. He's expected to be back sometime in December, so Sione Vaki will continue to handle RB2 duties behind Jahmyr Gibbs.

news.text: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.. Pacheco has been sidelined for the entirety of the regular season to this point after undergoing back surgery in September. Sione Vaki has been working as the Lions' clear RB2, though Jahmyr Gibbs has been a true workhorse out of the backfield. If Pacheco does return at the end of the regular season, it's hard to envision him having a big impact coming off back surgery.

players.outlook: Sanders enters his second NFL season set to back up Deshaun Watson in Cleveland. Sanders made eight appearances during his rookie season and wasn't overly productive, scoring eight all-purpose touchdowns, throwing 10 interceptions and completing 57% of his passes. The fifth-round pick produced one weekly fantasy finish better than 18th, though it was an impressive 364-yard passing game with four total touchdowns (33.5 points). Sanders added some value with his legs, including 20-plus yards in five straight games to end the season. The 24-year-old remains a wild card and is likely to earn some

Tyler Allgeier should remain Arizona's lead RB against the Rams in Week 10. Allgeier took on that role this past Sunday in a loss to Arizona and finished with 46 yards on 17 carries along with zero yards on two catches while drawing three targets. It was a quiet performance against a premier defense, but Allgeier seems likely to continue to lead the Cardinals' backfield while Jeremiyah Love (ankle) remains sidelined. Allgeier faces another tough draw in Week 10, as the Rams have yielded the fourth-fewest fantasy points per game (14.2) to running backs this season.

Carson Beck is expected to make his NFL debut as the Cardinals' starting quarterback in Week 10 against the Rams. Beck has yet to take a snap this season, but he's being pressed into a starting role after Jacoby Brissett was traded last weekend and after Gardner Minshew suffered a potentially season-ending elbow injury in Week 9. Beck will be working with an injury-riddled offense, as RB Jeremiyah Love is on IR due to an ankle injury and wideouts Michael Wilson (neck) and Kendrick Bourne (tibia) are out for the season. It may be a tough opening assignment for Beck, as the Rams rank seventh in

Justin Herbert is coming off another shaky performance in the Chargers' Week 9 loss to the Texans, completing fewer than 60% of his pass attempts and throwing his league-leading 11th interception of the season. The 28-year-old quarterback has yet to throw multiple TDs in any game this season, as the addition of offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel has been a complete disaster for the Chargers. He also emerged from the loss to Houston with a finger injury on his non-throwing hand. The issue doesn't seem likely to cost him any time, however. Herbert will try to begin righting the ship in Week 10

Will Reichard will look to stay involved as the Vikings play the Packers in Week 10. Reichard got back on track in a Week 9 loss to the Bills, making both of his two field-goal attempts. The kicker has now made two or more field goals in all but two of his eight outings this campaign, but the efficiency of the Vikings' offense could improve with Kirk Cousins taking over as the starting QB, turning some of his FG volume into PATs. Green Bay has also ranked a tough first in fantasy points allowed to kickers this campaign.

Cam Ward had his best game of the season in Tennessee's 43-36 Week 8 loss to the Bengals, prior to a Week 9 bye. He threw for 300 yards for the first time in his career and delivered a pair of touchdown passes for his first multi-TD performance through the air all season. Ward has a chance to build on that effort in Week 10 against a Jaguars defense that has been more vulnerable through the air than on the ground. The far larger sample of subpar football from the 2025 first overall pick prior to his strong outing last game suggests Ward remains tough to trust for now, even in superflex formats

Matthew Stafford will have to operate without his favorite target in the Rams' Week 10 tilt against Arizona. Puka Nacua, who Stafford has targeted at least 10 times in five of his past six games, has a knee injury that is expected to require a stint on IR. The Rams are also still without Davante Adams (hamstring - IR), so Stafford will have to look to other wideouts, as well as the tight-end corps, more often moving forward. He'll at least have a promising matchup in Week 10, as the Cardinals have allowed the third-most fantasy points (23.9) to quarterbacks this season.

TreVeyon Henderson is uncertain to face the Lions in Week 10 due to an ongoing illness when the Patriots travel to Munich. Henderson has not played since Week 7, and New England has a bye week following their travels, which will allow Henderson additional time to recover. With Rhamondre Stevenson dealing with a knee injury, Corey Kiner could lead this backfield against a defense that is allowing the third-fewest fantasy points to opposing rushers.

news.text: Henderson (illness) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.. Henderson was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich, and now that he's on IR, the second-year running back will be required to miss at least the next four games. Henderson's next opportunity to play is Week 15 against the Chiefs on Monday, Dec. 21, although there's no timetable for his return, as he is recovering from "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of neurological symptoms." If Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) cannot play Sunday, then the Patriots' backfield will be led by Corey Kiner and Lan Larison.

players.outlook: In Week 10, KC Concepcion and the Browns are home for the first time since Week 6 to host the Texans. He grabbed four of six targets for 85 yards, including a 64-yard touchdown, during Cleveland's 23-22 overtime loss in Week 9. The score was the rookie wideout's first of his young career, and he now sports a 37-437-1 receiving line on 55 targets to go along with 10 carries for 37 yards through nine games. Concepcion will aim to take advantage of a Houston defense allowing the third-most fantasy points per game (38.5) to opposing WRs.

Fernando Mendoza will take over under center in Week 10 with the Raiders dealing Kirk Cousins to the Vikings for a 2027 third-round pick. Mendoza has only appeared once this season, playing during garbage time of a Week 5 loss to the Patriots. The No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft was not impressive during camp but has looked solid in recent practices. His first game as a starter will come against the stout Seahawks defense. It won't get any easier in Week 11 versus the Broncos, so it's best to take the wait-and-see approach before trusting the rookie for fantasy production.

Jalen Hurts struggled again last game for the Eagles. Hurts completed just 21-of-40 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown in the ugly 19-17 loss to the Jaguars. Hurts has yet to throw for 300 yards in a game this season. He also had by far his worst rushing output of the 2026 campaign with only two yards on the ground, perhaps due to a nagging calf issue. In Week 6, Philadelphia will face a curious Carolina Panthers pass defense. Carolina is allowing 230.8 passing yards per tilt, which is 22nd in the NFL. However, the Panthers have yielded just five passing touchdowns, which is tied for fourth

news.text: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.. Initially diagnosed with a superficial blood clot after being cleated in the left calf in an Oct. 4 loss to the Rams, Hurts had been cleared by doctors to play in Week 5 in the Eagles' loss to the Jaguars in London before more recent testing last week showed that the blood clot had moved. According to a statement released Monday by his agent, Nicole Lynn, Hurts now has been diagnosed with a deep vein thrombosis in the left calf, as well as bilateral pulmonary emboli.

players.outlook: Alec Pierce aggravated a left heel injury in Week 2, stemming from his offseason left ankle surgery. The Colts' leading receiver from last season probably faces a multi-week absence and won't play against the Texans in Week 3. Josh Downs and Keenan Allen are set to lead Indianapolis' underwhelming WR room versus Houston.

news.text: When asked Wednesday whether Pierce (heel) has a chance to return from IR this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen was noncommittal, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.. "We'll see. Like I said last week, he's still in that rehab process, and I'm not going to put a timetable on return," Steichen noted of the wideout, who's been on IR since Sept. 26. At 2-7, the Colts were sellers ahead of the NFL's trade deadline, so the team presumably has no reason rush Pierce back. With Keenan Allen and Josh Downs no longer in the mix, Indy's healthy WRs for now are Ashton Dulin, Laquon Treadwell, Anthony Gould, Deion Burks and Nick Westbrook-Ikhine.

players.outlook: Tyjae Spears hasn't suited up since Week 6 due to a knee injury and has also dealt with an ankle injury this season. Even if he returns to his customary change-of-pace role for the Titans in Week 10, Spears is unlikely to contribute much against a Jacksonville defense that has been elite at containing RBs. If the Titans trade lead back Tony Pollard, Spears could see an uptick in work, but the biggest beneficiary in that scenario would likely be rookie fifth-round pick Nicholas Singleton.

news.text: Spears (knee) was limited in practice Thursday.. The running back returned to action last Sunday against the Jaguars and logged 16 snaps behind Tony Pollard's 41. Spears is only playable in Week 11 against Dallas as a desperation fantasy option.

players.outlook: George Holani and the Seahawks host the Chiefs on Sunday Night Football in Week 7. He rushed five times for 20 yards and a touchdown during Seattle's 17-14 loss in overtime in Week 6. Holani made the most of his touches by scoring his first rushing TD of the season, but he's expected to have his opportunities reduced with the likely return of Zach Charbonnet (knee) off the reserve/PUP list. It would be wise to steer clear of the Seahawks backfield against a Kansas City defense allowing 19.0 fantasy points allowed per game to RBs, which is tied for ninth.

In Week 10, Germie Bernard and the Steelers visit the Bengals in an AFC North showdown. He brought in all five of his targets for 30 yards during Pittsburgh's 27-6 victory in Week 8. The rookie paced the team in receptions, finished second in targets behind DK Metcalf (6), and was third in yardage in a game Aaron Rodgers completed just 13 passes for 172 yards. Bernard will try to get back on track against a Cincinnati defense allowing 31.1 fantasy points per game (15th) to WRs.

Bam Knight will look to clear concussion protocol in time to play in Arizona's Week 10 matchup against the Rams. Knight missed the team's Week 9 loss to Seattle after being concussed Week 8. If he's able to play against Los Angeles, Knight could have a prominent role in the backfield beside Tyler Allgeier, as Jeremiyah Love is on IR due to an ankle injury. However, the Cardinals' backfield as a whole faces a tough test against a Rams defense that is yielding just 3.55 yards per carry to running backs, fourth-best in the NFL.

Elijah Mitchell led the Eagles in rushing last game. Jaydon Blue was initially thought to be the primary backup to Saquon Barkley, but it was Mitchell who led the Eagles with 34 yards on the ground. In fact, Blue did not even register a carry in the 27-10 loss to the Commanders. Barkley has been assured he will not be traded, leaving Blue as an afterthought, and perhaps even behind Mitchell on the depth chart. Meanwhile, a potentially juicy matchup is on the horizon in Week 9 versus the Giants for whomever is the bell cow. New York is allowing 128.1 rushing yards per tilt, which is 26th in the

Tank Bigsby replaced an injured Saquon Barkley last game for the Eagles, only to suffer an injury of his own late in the contest. Bigsby rushed 14 times for 55 yards to lead the Eagles before exiting with a lower-body issue. His status is up in the air for Week 5 versus the Jags. If neither Bigsby nor Barkley can play, Will Shipley would be in line for an expanded role. However, Jacksonville has played the run extremely well thus far in 2026. The Jags are allowing just 74.3 rushing yards per tote, which us second in the NFL.

news.text: The Eagles placed Bigsby (abdomen) on injured reserve Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.. Bigsby will undergo core muscle surgery for an abdominal injury that he picked up during the Eagles' Week 4 loss to the Rams. The fourth-year pro will be required to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 9 against the Giants. Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is also considered week-to-week, so with Bigsby on IR, Will Shipley could be the Eagles' starting running back for Week 5 against the Jaguars on Sunday in London.

players.outlook: Jordan Addison will look to get more volume in Week 10 as the Vikings play the Packers. Addison finished a Week 9 loss with two catches for 28 yards off three targets, but struggles from the QB room didn't leave much room for any pass catchers to succeed. The trade deadline acquisition of Kirk Cousins to be Minnesota's new starting quarterback could be just the spark Addison needs, as he's recorded less than 30 yards in two of his last three games. Green Bay has ranked 27th in fantasy points allowed to WRs this campaign.

news.text: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.. Thus, the Vikings are expecting Addison to recover fully before the four games required of an IR stint, but in any case he will miss some time due to the thumb injury he suffered in practice last Friday and sidelined him this past Sunday at Green Bay. With Addison out of the lineup, Minnesota will be relying on Justin Jefferson, Jauan Jennings (calf), Myles Price, Tai Felton and Jeshaun Jones at wide receiver.

players.outlook: Jaleel McLaughlin and the Browns are in Tennessee for an interconference tilt in Week 7. He rushed nine times for 41 yards and caught all four targets for another 14 yards during Cleveland's Week 6 win. With Quinshon Judkins (ankle) inactive, McLaughlin and Audric Estime each tallied nine carries to lead the backfield. McLaughlin paced the team in yardage and tied for the lead in receptions. If Judkins can't play against the Titans' 13th-ranked defense in fantasy points allowed per game (20.3) to RBs, McLaughlin could find himself busy again.

Makai Lemon set career highs across the board last game for the Eagles. With both DeVonta Smith as well as Dontayvion Wicks sidelined due to injury, Lemon snagged seven passes for 67 yards and his first NFL touchdown. He was targeted eight times in the contest. If Smith and/or Wicks are unable to suit up in Week 8 versus the Commanders, Lemon could have a delicious matchup, even with backup quarterback Tanner McKee under center. The Patriots have ranked a tough fifth in fantasy points allowed to running backs this season.

Austin Ekeler had a season-high 10 touches last game for Washington. Unfortunately, he managed just 34 yards with those opportunities, and the Commanders fell to the Rams by a score of 20-13. Ekeler has 16 carries over the last two contests, though continues to serve as the backup to Rachaad White. In Week 10, Ekeler will face a Giants defense that has been better against the pass than the run in 2026. New York is allowing just 177.8 passing yards per clash, which is third in the NFL. However, the Giants are surrendering 123.6 rushing yards per tilt, which is 21st in the league.

Chris Godwin will look to bounce back from a lackluster Week 8 performance when the Buccaneers face the Bears in Week 9. He struggled along with the rest of Tampa Bay's receiving corps in last week's rainy win over the Falcons, as Baker Mayfield completed no passes. If Emeka Egbuka (foot) misses his third consecutive game in Week 9, Godwin would operate as Tampa Bay's top wideout. Even so, the Buccaneers have attempted just 14 passes over the last two weeks, so Godwin's fantasy production is capped by the team's limited passing volume. Chris Brooks will look to make a return as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Brooks has been on IR with an ankle injury and while his required four games out were fulfilled ahead of Week 9 against the Patriots, Green Bay decided to not activate him. The fourth-year ball carrier will likely need to log at least one full practice this week if he hopes to take on a Minnesota defense that's ranked top 10 against fantasy running backs.

Kaleb Johnson will aim to stay involved as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Johnson served as Green Bay's lead back after Josh Jacobs left in the first quarter of a Week 9 win over the Patriots. Pierre Strong could see an elevated role as the Packers play the Vikings in Week 10. Strong logged eight carries for 22 yards and two catches for 11 yards in a Week 9 win over the Patriots, with MarShawn Lloyd and Josh Jacobs both dealing with injuries. The fourth-year ball carrier has served a change-of-pace role in his five appearances this season, but he could see even bigger usage if his position mates are inactive. Minnesota has ranked top 10 in fantasy points allowed to RBs this campaign.

Dameon Pierce still managed to maintain a solid role despite the return of Saquon Barkley from injury for the Eagles.  Barkley rushed seven times for 62 yards and a touchdown but tweaked his hamstring while also suffering a compensatory back injury. players.outlook: Emari Demercado continues to play backup to Javonte Williams following the Malik Davis injury, but Demercado has had a marginal role through the first two games for Dallas. Demercado has five carries for a combined 15 yards behind Williams. Even if he receives a few extra touches, Demercado will have a difficult time finding room in Week 3 versus Baltimore. The Ravens are allowing just 83.5 rushing yards per tilt, which is sixth in the NFL.

Tyler Goodson is set to miss multiple weeks for the Cowboys due to a sprained knee. The timing is rough for Goodson, who is coming off his best performance of the season. Goodson rushed 12 times for 77 yards in the 27-23 win over the Colts. Either Israel Abanikanda or Jashaun Corbin will likely slide in as the backup running back, though neither is a reasonable option against a 49ers defense allowing just 80.9 rushing yards per game, which is second in the league.

Justice Hill and the Ravens host the winless Chargers on Monday Night Football in Week 10. He erupted for 85 yards on nine carries, including a 65-yard TD run, and caught all three of his targets for seven yards during Baltimore's Week 9 loss. With Jacoby Brissett expected to start under center, Hill and the Ravens' offense could start to become a bit more pass-friendly, but that's certainly no guarantee. He'll look to keep contributing against the Chargers' 21st-ranked defense in fantasy points allowed per game (22.8) to opposing RBs.

Keaton Mitchell made a bit of noise as a pass catcher in the Chargers' Week 9 loss to the Texans, catching three of four targets for 34 yards while turning seven carries into 33 yards. He remains mired in a backfield committee, with Omarion Hampton gaining a team-high 60 rushing yards on 13 carries while Kimani Vidal chipped in 36 scrimmage yards on eight touches. Najee Harris had five carries for just nine yards last game for the Giants. The running game as a whole was fairly contained, as starter Cam Skattebo rushed for just 58 yards in the 27-27 tie with Washington. Interestingly, Tyrone Tracy also had five touches in this contest, perhaps showing that the backup role remains up for grabs. In Week 6, the Giants will face a Saints defense that has been gutted on the ground thus far in 2026. New Orleans is allowing148.8 rushing yards per clash, which is 30th in the league. Isaiah Davis hasn't factored into the Jets' running plans despite Breece Hall's absence entering a Week 6 matchup with the Patriots. Davis has played a mere 11 offensive snaps in two games, rushing for eight yards on two carries while adding a nine-yard catch. Even if Hall doesn't return in Week 6, Davis would need further injury to Braelon Allen to collect enough touches to succeed against a run defense that's allowing 4.2 yards per carry.

Jaylen Wright didn't factor into the Dolphins' backfield even before a quad injury cost him Week 9. He'll need to overcome that issue if he's to take aim at Indianapolis' vulnerable run defense in Week 10. Wright has just 19 total carries across his last four games, with Ollie Gordon dominating touches. The Colts are allowing 4.8 yards per carry and the fifth-most fantasy points per game to opposing rushers, but Wright hasn't been afforded enough chances to take advantage of those deficiencies.

Michael Wilson could play in Arizona's Week 9 matchup against Seattle despite dealing with two broken ribs. The wideout suffered the injury this past Sunday in a win over Dallas, but he returned to the game after getting hurt and finished with eight catches for 111 yards and one touchdown on 15 targets. Wilson thrived with both Jacoby Brissett and Gardner Minshew under center, so the switch to Minshew as the Cardinals' starting QB shouldn't impact Wilson's production if he's able to suit up in Week 9. news.text: The Cardinals placed Wilson (neck) on injured reserve Tuesday.. Wilson's move to IR was merely a formality, after head coach Mike LaFleur announced Monday that the wideout would be sidelined for the rest of the season after sustaining a fractured vertebra in his neck during Sunday's 17-3 loss to the Seahawks. Per Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com, Wilson is expected to be in a neck brace for the next six weeks to two months, but the Cardinals don't view the injury as a long-term or career-threatening concern. The 26-year-old receiver will finish the 2026 campaign with 51 receptions for 546 yards and two touchdowns on 88 targets to go with 28 rushing yards on three carries across his nine appearances

players.outlook: Xavier Worthy was one of several Kansas City players to emerge from a Week 9 win over the Jets with an injury. The speedy wideout grabbed at his hamstring late in the victory after catching all six of his targets for 48 yards. Patrick Mahomes also suffered an injury to his throwing elbow, so even if Worthy doesn't end up missing time, his fantasy outlook could be affected by having Justin Fields under center instead. Wan'Dale Robinson should have enough short passes thrown his way to maintain flex appeal for Tennessee's Week 10 home game against the Jaguars. The 1-7 Titans are likely to fall behind against the 6-2 Jaguars and throw plenty against a Jacksonville secondary that's allowing 175 yards per game to WRs. Robinson has caught three of Cam Ward's six touchdown passes this season and has drawn at least six targets in four consecutive games, though the former Giants WR hasn't exceeded 57 yards in a Titans jersey.

Meanwhile Carnell Tate (shoulder) is slated to practice this week, and his potential return to action this weekend against Dallas figures to impact the playing time of Elic Ayomanor and Chimere Dike. Robinson's looming absence will free up snaps/targets in the slot, with Saleh noting Wednesday that he's looking forward to seeing what rookie slot option Xavier Restrepo can do with added opportunities going forward.

While Vidal turned eight touches into 36 scrimmage yards in a Week 9 loss to the Texans, Omarion Hampton gained a team-high 60 rushing yards on 13 carries, and Keaton Mitchell put together 67 scrimmage yards on 10 touches. That leaves Vidal dependent on TDs or injuries around him on the depth chart for value. He'll try to make a splash in Week 10 against a Ravens defense that ranks ninth in fantasy points per game allowed to RBs.

Mike Washington crashed back to earth in the Raiders' Week 9 loss to the 49ers, losing a total of three yards on six carries. Ashton Jeanty had little luck either, scratching out 20 scrimmage yards on 11 touches. Washington remains in the No. 2 spot on the depth chart, and his 3.9 yards per carry on the season is only marginally better than Jeanty's 3.2 mark. Seemingly losing snaps to Ty Johnson on passing downs in what was already a limited role, Davis's only fantasy appeal would be to James Cook managers in the event of an injury.

Emanuel Wilson's role for Week 8 against the Bears could depend on whether Zach Charbonnet (knee) and/or Jadarian Price (chest) is ready to rejoin Seattle's backfield. As the Seahawks' lead RB in Week 7 against Kansas City, Wilson racked up 100 yards and a touchdown on a hearty 24 carries and added one catch for 15 yards. Ty Johnson continues to flash in the Bills' passing game ahead of a Week 10 matchup with the Jets. He has only seven carries in six games but has brought in all 17 of his targets after snagging 24 balls in 17 games last season. While the volume is unlikely to be enough to merit fantasy consideration, the Jets have allowed four touchdown catches to opposing backs, the second-highest number in the league, which could allow Johnson to shine in Week 10.

Samaje Perine and the Bengals host the Steelers on Sunday Night Football in Week 10. He rushed 11 times for 43 yards and was not targeted during Cincinnati's 34-17 victory in Week 9. Perine played 42% of the offensive snaps compared to 62% for Chase Brown, although their workloads were much closer, with the latter out-touching the former 12-11. As it stands, with the Bengals lighting up opponents through the air, fantasy managers should find it difficult to trust either running back.

Brian Robinson (hamstring) is expected to operate as the Falcons' No. 2 running back if active for the Week 9 matchup against the Bengals. Robinson has been sidelined for two consecutive games due to a hamstring issue. However, he's been an effective runner when healthy, averaging 4.0 yards per carry and rushing for four touchdowns in six appearances this season. Despite this, he'll likely need to find the end zone to be fantasy relevant against a Bengals defense that's given up just 19.7 fantasy points per game to opposing running backs this year.

Robinson already has missed two games due to a lingering hamstring injury and now must miss at least the next four outings, meaning his next chance for game action is Sunday, Dec. 13 at Cleveland. In a corresponding move, the Falcons are signing Khalil Herbert from the practice squad to the active roster to continue serving as the No. 2 RB behind workhorse Bijan Robinson.

The trade acquisition from Arizona has just six catches for 60 yards and one TD in three appearances for Houston heading into a Week 10 trip to Cleveland. With Nico Collins, Tank Dell, Xavier Hutchinson and Kayshon Boutte also vying for targets in Houston's deep WR room, Harrison isn't a trustworthy Week 10 fantasy option. In his continued absence, Nico Collins, Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte and Tank Dell will handle the Texans' WR duties Thursday. Collins (16 targets, nine catches) and Hutchinson (nine targets, four catches) combined for 152 receiving yards on the 25 targets the duo saw against Cleveland in Week 10.

However, he managed just 45 scrimmage yards on eight touches overall. Meanwhile, Devin Singletary had 33 yards on five touches, Najee Harris eked out just two rushing yards on four carries and Cam Skattebo did not even register a touch following last week's costly fumble. It will be hard to trust any New York running back until one emerges from the pack. In Week 7, the Giants will also face a stingy Texans run defense. The Giants haven't provided any updates on Tracy since he landed on IR on Oct. 27 after sustaining a hamstring strain in a Week 7 win over the Texans, but the running back is seemingly progressing well and could be ready to play once he sits out the required four games. Once he's reinstated, Tracy could operate as a change-of-pace option behind Cam Skattebo, who appears to have reclaimed the lead role out of the New York backfield after a one-game benching in Week 6.

Conner restructured his contract during the offseason, but his days as Arizona's lead back are over after Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier were added to the roster during the offseason. players.outlook: Seth McGowan is poised to remain the Colts' No. 2 RB with Jonathan Taylor staying with the team. The rookie seventh-round pick is averaging a solid 4.8 yards per carry, though he has exceeded six rushing attempts in a game just once in his young career. It would have been a juicy introduction to the lead role in a favorable Week 10 matchup against a Dolphins defense that has allowed nine TDs to RBs in eight games en route to a 1-7 record. Now, he's only a deep-league flex option.

Antonio Williams tied for third on the Commanders in targets last game.  Unfortunately, despite seeing six targets, Williams managed only three catches for 25 yards in the 20-13 loss to the Rams. Williams is unlikely to break loose in Week 10 versus the Giants either. New York is allowing just 177.8 passing yards per tilt, which is third in the NFL.

Brenton Strange is a viable fantasy option in Week 10 against the Titans, but he's far from a must-start. He leads the Jaguars with 30 catches through eight games but hasn't scored since the season opener and is averaging 45 yards per game, which ranks 10th among TEs. Tennessee has struggled to defend the pass in general, but the Titans have limited TEs to 43 yards per game, though they have also given up four TDs to the position through eight games.

Hill is currently a free agent after being released by Miami. One of the top fantasy players of the past decade, Hill's best days may be behind him as he enters his age-32 campaign. The former fifth-round pick was fantasy's top-scoring receiver from 2017-23, but struggled to an 18th-place finish in 2024 (31st PPG) and then suffered a season-ending knee injury in Week 4 of last season. If he's able to play in 2026, Hill may still be able to hit for the occasional explosive play, but considering his age and the major injury, his ceiling is likely that of a boom/bust flex.

news.text: Hill's (knee) agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver hasn't yet been medically cleared but is expected to be "in a few weeks," James Palmer of Bleacher Report reports.. Though his outlook hasn't changed much since Rosenhaus last provided an update in mid-October, Hill is seemingly getting closer to being ready to take the field. It's unclear what type of interest Hill has garnered around the league, but he's a free agent and could hold some appeal for teams once doctors give him the green light to play.

In Week 10, he will look to take advantage of a porous Washington secondary. The Commanders are allowing 240 passing yards per clash, which is 30th in the league. In addition, Washington has surrendered 16 passing touchdowns, which is tied for 25th in the league.

Pat Bryant has missed the last four games for the Broncos due to an ankle injury, but his time on IR could be coming to an end. Prior to the injury, the second-year wideout had put together a 9-133-1 line on 12 targets over his first four contests of the season, serving as a reliable possession receiver for Bo Nix. If Bryant is cleared to suit up in Week 9, he'll be facing a Panthers team that just fired its defensive coordinator and is tied for 15th in fantasy points per game allowed to WRs.

Mack Hollins' opportunities for the Patriots in Week 10 against the Lions appear unsettled with A.J. Brown (knee) potentially returning to action. Hollins returned from a four-week absence in Week 9, catching half of his six targets and finding the end zone for the first time all season. While Detroit's secondary has been picked on often and allows 8.0 yards per target, Hollins doesn't have a clear path to heavy volume, leading to big-play or touchdown dependency.

Tutu Atwell will have a chance to step into a larger role for the Rams in Week 10 against Arizona. Atwell has logged a modest four catches for 68 yards on nine targets over his past two games after going catchless in Week 7. However, Puka Nacua is expected to land on IR due to a knee injury, so the Rams are going to need to look to other wideouts, potentially including Atwell, to step up in the passing game. A matchup against the Cardinals presents a good opportunity, as they rank 24th in the NFL with 22.2 fantasy points per game allowed to wide receivers.

Kayshon Boutte had four catches for 125 yards and two TDs in Week 9 against the Chargers, recording his best game in a Texans uniform. Prior to that outburst, Boutte was averaging under 28 receiving yards per game and hadn't scored a TD all season. He demonstrated that his ceiling is high enough to warrant a dart throw if you're desperate, but Boutte will be hard-pressed to repeat Week 9's production in Week 10 against the Browns since playing time remains hard to come by in a Texans WR room that also includes Nico Collins, Tank Dell, Xavier Hutchinson and Marvin Harrison.
